note: White River NF (Dillon RD) campground in the Cataract Creek drainage above Green Mountain Reservoir: off Heeney Rd (County Rd 30) 5.3 mi from Hwy 9, then Cataract Creek Rd (FDR 1725). Trails into the Eagles Nest Wilderness nearby, including the Lower Cataract Lake trailhead. --Claude
summary: FS page: confirmed 5 sites, vault toilet, no potable water, $23 (2026); FCFS confirmed (no recreation.gov listing). Cleared the derived max_rig_ft 25 (Campendium-only). Note trimmed of field restatements and the unsourced size remarks.
flags: Website is the forest's home page; give THIS campground's FS page: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/cataract-creek-campground
Missing phone: Dillon Ranger District (970) 468-5400 (FS page Office Contact).

Pin ~690 m off: the stored 39.8380,-106.3150 sits in open sagebrush beside the road to the Lower Cataract Lake trailhead with no pads visible. The FS page's point 39.83879,-106.30699 is at the head of a short spur into the conifers south of Cataract Creek Rd, which is where a 5-site campground shows on imagery (sites under canopy). Suggest re-pinning to the FS point.

RIG LENGTH (criteria check): the agency's own words are only 'This small campground with 5 campsites'; it says nothing about rig size and singles out no RV limit, so there is no agency wording to act on. Aggregators disagree and none is agency: ParkAdvisor and AllStays list a 21-ft max RV length; Campendium lists 'Longest Vehicle Reported' 25 ft and calls it small-RVs-only. Its one review (2025-07-22) says 'Only five sites, somewhat close together' and gives no rig. No review from the last 3 years reporting a 23-ft+ rig fitting was found. Human call: the 21-ft aggregator figure would fail the 23-ft rule if the Dillon RD confirmed it (970-468-5400).

Waterfront re-audit lead (waterfront NOT changed): stored 'lakeview near Green Mountain Reservoir' looks unsupported. On imagery the campground spur is inside dense conifer; Green Mountain Reservoir is not within ~2.3 km of the site (outside a 4.7 km frame centred on it), and Lower Cataract Lake (~1 km SW) is behind trees and a rise. The FS's 'just above Green Mountain Reservoir' describes the drainage, not a view. Likely 'not waterfront'.

Season and status: the FS page gives no season; it defers 'Dates and pricing' to the forest's Developed Campgrounds list, which gives none for Cataract Creek. No White River NF alert names Cataract Creek or FDR 1725.
